title: Data Analyst - Systems Transformation
text: Data Analyst - Systems Transformation at HCF Australia (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). About HCF HCF is Australia's largest not for profit private health insurer. With over 80 years of heritage in Australia, we remain faithful to our not for profit charter and continue to deliver more benefits to our members. With the adoption of our 2020 Strategy, our vision is to make health care understandable, affordable, high quality and customer centric. HCF Australia is undergoing a strategic transformation to deliver new business capabilities to meet its strategic plan. As a key driver in the change, IT is at the forefront of the design and implementation of new systems and supports the ongoing change management, support and delivery of the overall business transformation. About the Role The purpose of this role is to provide Business Intelligence analysis and support on HCF’s data and its structures; provision of accurate and timely data extracts and models which will assist key decision makers with the information they need to drive business processes. You will be responsible for the following: Liaise with business decision-makers to understand their information needs Provide data extracts, models and reports to meet business requirements Manipulate and analyse data looking for patterns Interpret and present analysis and modelling results in a business context Provide ongoing data support to the business units Prepare test data to support system changes Documentation (as required) Cooperate with HCF in relation to activities taken by the company to comply with WHS legislation Participate in meetings, training and other health and safety activities About you Knowledgeable in the use of CRoss-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRISP-DM) Relevant tertiary degree and/or experience in a commercial environment Strong SQL and data extraction knowledge, with experience in handling large volumes of data Use of SPSS or equivalent modelling software is desired Excellent verbal/written communication skills. Ability to exercise discretion in dealing with confidential information. Must be a team player committed to working in a continuously improving and quality environment Independent decision making capability and pro-active problem-solving skills. Highly developed negotiation and relationship building skills Good business, systems and process analysis skills If you meet the requirements above, please send your application through.
